settings.headline:
A roof that
outlasts the weather.
settings.copy: Summit Ridge Roofing is a family-owned roofing contractor that treats your home like our own. From a single shingle repair to a full tear-off and re-roof, we install systems built to shrug off hail, wind, and decades of sun — and we back every job with a workmanship warranty that actually means something.

trust_list.text: Licensed, bonded, and insured in every county we serve
Free, no-pressure roof inspections and honest estimates
Storm-damage specialists who work with your insurance

stats.label: Year workmanship warranty on every install

settings.title: Every roof,
settings.intro: Whether you need a fast repair before a storm or a full replacement that will outlast the mortgage, we have the crew, the materials, and the warranty to do it right.

design.title: Full tear-off & re-roof
design.text: We strip the old roof down to the deck, inspect and repair the sheathing, and install a new system with proper underlayment, flashing, and ventilation.

design.title: Architectural & metal roofing
design.text: From dimensional asphalt shingles to standing-seam metal, we install the material that fits your home, your budget, and your climate.

build.title: Leak & storm repair
build.text: A leak today is a bigger problem tomorrow. We find the source, fix it right, and make sure the repair is warrantied — not just patched.

build.title: Preventive maintenance
build.text: Annual inspections, gutter cleaning, and small repairs that stop small problems from becoming expensive ones. We keep your roof healthy.

launch.title: Insurance claims help
launch.text: After hail or wind damage, we document the damage, work directly with your adjuster, and make sure you get the coverage you're owed.

launch.title: Emergency tarping
launch.text: Storm hit and your roof is compromised? We respond fast to tarp and secure your home, then schedule the permanent repair.

settings.title: The roof is
settings.intro: Your roof is the only thing between your family and the sky. We build ours to be the last roof you'll think about for decades. Here's what that means.

features.title: Factory-certified installers
features.text: Our crews are GAF-certified, which means your roof carries a manufacturer-backed warranty on top of our own workmanship guarantee.

features.title: Honest, itemized estimates
features.text: You get a clear, line-item estimate before we start. No surprise charges, no 'we found more damage' games after the work begins.

features.title: We protect your property
features.text: Landscaping, driveways, and siding get covered and protected before we start. We leave your yard cleaner than we found it.

features.title: 50-year workmanship warranty
features.text: If our workmanship fails, we fix it — for free, for fifty years. That's how confident we are in how we install.

features.title: Storm specialists
features.text: We've handled thousands of insurance claims. We know how to document damage and advocate for the coverage you're owed.

features.title: Local and accountable
features.text: We're a family business that lives in the communities we roof. Our name and our reputation are on every job.

settings.title: From inspection
settings.intro: A clear, no-surprises process that takes you from a free inspection to a roof you can forget about. Here's what to expect at every step.

steps.title: Free inspection & estimate
steps.text: We climb up, inspect your roof and attic, and give you an honest assessment with a clear, itemized estimate. No pressure, no obligation.

steps.title: Materials & scheduling
steps.text: We order the right materials for your roof and climate, and schedule a crew that will show up on time and finish on schedule.

steps.title: Tear-off & install
steps.text: We protect your property, tear off the old roof, repair the deck, and install the new system with proper flashing and ventilation.

steps.title: Final walkthrough & warranty
steps.text: We clean up, walk the roof with you, and hand over your warranty paperwork. You get a roof that's built to last and backed in writing.

settings.note: Most residential re-roofs are completed in one to three days. We'll give you a firm start date and keep you posted — and we always leave your property cleaner than we found it.

settings.title: Roofs they
settings.intro: We asked homeowners what it was like to work with Summit Ridge. They said: on time, honest, and a roof that finally feels done. Here's a few of their stories.

reviews.quote: After a hailstorm, three companies gave me wildly different numbers. Summit Ridge walked the roof with me, showed me the damage, and handled the insurance claim start to finish. The new roof is beautiful and the process was painless.
reviews.author: Karen M.

reviews.quote: They showed up exactly when they said, protected my flower beds, and finished in two days. The crew was polite and the cleanup was spotless. This is how contractors should operate.
reviews.author: Dave T.

reviews.quote: We had a leak that two other companies couldn't find. Summit Ridge found it in an hour, fixed it, and warrantied the work. I've already recommended them to three neighbors.
reviews.author: Priya S.

settings.title: Let's talk
settings.intro: Tell us about your roof and we'll schedule a free, no-pressure inspection. We'll give you an honest assessment and a clear estimate — whether you need a repair or a full replacement.
